title: Nucleus of M31: Upper limits to the molecular and ionised gas content
question: Place constraints on the cold molecular and warm ionised gas content around the supermassive black hole in the nucleus of M31 to test stellar mass-loss gas accumulation and Sgr A*-like ionised accretion disc scenarios.

data.sensitivity: 3sigma line upper limit 0.15 Jy km/s (for 1000 km/s window); 3sigma continuum upper limits 96, 93, 150 uJy/beam

what.value: Predicted CO(1–0) signal of 2 mJy with line width 1000 km/s corresponding to 10^4 M_sun of molecular gas

evidence.quote: The mass loss from these stars is expected to fill a molecular gas disc within the tidal truncation of 1 pc (= 0.26 arcsec) of 10 [4] _M_ ⊙, corresponding to a CO(1–0) signal of 2 mJy with a line width of 1000 km/s.
This rules out the original prediction of Chang et al. (2007), namely a CO(1–0) flux of 2 mJy with a line width of 1000 km s [−][1], corresponding to a molecular mass of 10 [4] _M_ ⊙

what.value: H30α recombination line parameters and flux (3 mJy, 2200 km/s) detected in the MW for Sgr A*

evidence.quote: In Table 4, we summarise our results given our initial assumptions scaled from the previous observations of the H30α recombination line detected in the MW for SgrA* by Murchikova et al. (2019).

what.value: Lower-frequency radio continuum measurements and synchrotron power-law fit

evidence.quote: The blue and orange points correspond to the measurements of Crane et al. (1992, 1993), and Yang et al. (2017).
Our upper limits are compatible with the synchrotron power-law emission that was derived from lower-frequency measurements (Crane et al. 1992, 1993; Yang et al. 2017).

external_data.citation: Crane et al. (1992, 1993); Yang et al. (2017)

what.value: Sound speed of the gas c_s = 550 km s^-1

evidence.quote: Relying on Baganoff et al. (2003), who estimated _c_ _s_ = 550 km s [−][1], we found a typical size of 4.2 pc, which is well sampled by our observations (0.3 [′′] or a resolution of 1.1 pc).

what.value: Optical Hα-emitting disc luminosity L_Hα = (8.7 ± 1) x 10^2 L_sun and radius 0.7'' (2.7 pc)

evidence.quote: In the optical, Menezes et al. (2013) discovered an eccentric Hα-emitting disc in the nucleus of M31, with a radius of 0.7 [′′] .
The authors estimated that this gas disc with a radius of 2.7 pc has a luminosity of _L_ _H_ α = (8.7±1)×10 [2] _L_ ⊙ .

recipe.goal: Measure 3sigma upper limits on line intensities and continuum fluxes
recipe.method: Compute 3sigma (99.7% CL) upper limits on integrated line flux over a 1000 km/s window centred on systemic velocity (and 2200 km/s for H30a), and continuum upper limits from the available bandwidth and spatial standard deviation over an area covering ten times the beam at the optical phase centre position.
key_parameters: Delta V_max = 1000 km/s (and 2200 km/s for H30alpha); 3sigma (99.7% CL); area = 10 x beam for stacked continuum

recipe.goal: Derive 3sigma upper limits on intrinsic CO luminosity and molecular hydrogen mass
recipe.method: Calculate intrinsic CO luminosity L'_CO from velocity-integrated line flux using Solomon et al. (1997) Eq. 1, then convert to total molecular gas mass M_H2 using alpha_CO and CO line ratios R_1J (Eq. 2).
assumptions: CO line ratios R_12 = 1.3 and R_13 = 1.8
Galactic conversion factor alpha_CO = 4.36 M_sun / (K km s^-1 pc^2), including 36% helium correction

recipe.goal: Scale expected H30alpha recombination line emission from Sgr A* to M31* and compare with NOEMA upper limit
recipe.method: Rescale Bondi radius, gas mass, and H30alpha integrated signal from MW (Sgr A*) to M31 based on black hole mass ratio (35) and distance ratio (97), and compare predicted flux with observed 3sigma upper limit.
key_parameters: M_BH(M31) = 1.4 x 10^8 M_sun (35 x MW); D(M31) = 780 kpc (97 x MW); Delta V = 2200 km/s
assumptions: Sound speed c_s = 550 km s^-1, same plasma characteristics (ionised gas surface density mu, sound speed c_s, plane thickness h) and masing amplification factor as Sgr A*

score_reason: The paper uses standard ALMA pipeline products and simple analytical equations (Eqs. 1-10) with explicitly stated conversion factors to compute 3sigma upper limits from noise maps. However, it omits software versions, imaging weighting, and exact spatial/spectral extraction details for the line rms.
rediscovery_reason: The ALMA dataset (2019.1.00711.S) is public, standard pipeline products were used, and the main ALMA results are simple 3sigma noise upper limits on CO(3-2) flux, luminosity, H2 mass, and Band 7 continuum using fully specified analytical formulas.
